string.name: title
string.value: 2. The Better To Hear You With

string.name: text
string.value: While exploring the Six Path Crossway, you bumped into a stranger.

string.name: text
string.value: He ignored you, so you playfully snatched away his hat... only to discover he sported a pair of unusually large ears.

string.name: text
string.value: He grumpily revealed that his name was Rondo and that he was searching Maple World for others like himself.

string.name: text
string.value: You accompanied him to Grandis, where you learned about the Anima tribe.

string.name: text
string.value: But you couldn't get to the Anima village, since Grandis was at war.

string.name: text
string.value: You traveled as far as the border, but a barrier prevented you from proceeding.

string.name: text
string.value: Rondo vowed to return someday to find out if the Anima tribe were really his people.
